AC amendment (gap-analysis: missing_error_rollback): Closure Checks section must include the direct-invocation command so the completion-verifier LLM can execute it and observe the P1 verdict.

The ## Closure Checks section must include the exact invocation command so the dso:completion-verifier agent can run it inline during epic closure:

  'Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh | bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-verifier-verdict.sh'

This makes the FAIL path visible to the completion-verifier even without project_closure_hooks configured — the verifier LLM reads the Closure Checks item, executes the Verify command, and records the P1 verdict in closure_checks_results.

Additional verify step: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 | jq -r '.description' | grep -q 'check-verifier-verdict.sh'
